newsitem.title: SWEDEN: IBM in $55 million deal with Pharmacia & Upjohn.
newsitem.headline: IBM in $55 million deal with Pharmacia & Upjohn.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp. said Friday that it signed a $55 million deal with Swedish-U.S. drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn under which IBM will modernise and operate P&U's information systems.
"A contract has been signed between IBM Global Servies and drugs giant Pharmacia & Upjohn," IBM Svenska AB said in a statement.
"The contract states that Pharmacia & Upjohn will turn over operation and maintenance of its large computer system for its Swedish and U.S. offices to IBM."
IBM, which had previously provided PC support for Pharmacia & Upjohn in Stockholm, said it will streamline and modify P&U information technology systems under the five-year contract.
